description.id: Kawasan kepulauan maritim Nusantara dan daratan Indochina yang kaya akan animisme purba, kosmologi Hindu-Buddha, dan tradisi kesultanan Islam.
description.en: Maritime archipelagos and mainland Indochina imbued with ancient animism, Hindu-Buddhist cosmology, and Islamic sultanate folklore.

description.id: Peradaban Tiongkok, Jepang, dan Korea yang dipengaruhi Shinto, Taoisme, Konfusianisme, dan Buddhisme Mahayana.
description.en: Chinese, Japanese, and Korean civilizations shaped by Shinto, Daoism, Confucian philosophy, and Mahayana Buddhism.

description.id: Tradisi lembah Sungai Indus dan Gangga yang melahirkan kosmologi Weda, epos Mahabharata dan Ramayana.
description.en: Indus and Ganges River valley traditions giving rise to Vedic cosmology and monumental Sanskrit epics.

description.id: Mitologi klasik Mediterania (Yunani & Romawi), tradisi Zaman Besi Keltik, paganisme Slavia, dan kosmologi Zaman Viking Skandinavia.
description.en: Classical Hellenic lore, Celtic Iron Age oral traditions, Slavic paganism, and Scandinavian Viking Age mythology.

description.id: Kawasan Bulan Sabit Subur, sastra Persia kuno, tradisi Semitik, dan kisah-kisah Seribu Satu Malam.
description.en: The Fertile Crescent, ancient Persian epics, Semitic folklore, and Arabian Nights traditions.

description.id: Tradisi lembah Sungai Nil Mesir Kuno serta tradisi lisan Afrika Barat dan Sub-Sahara (Yoruba, Akan, Zulu).
description.en: Ancient Egyptian Nile cosmology and West and Sub-Saharan African oral traditions (Yoruba, Akan, Zulu).

description.id: Kosmologi purba Aztek, Maya, dan Toltek seputar siklus matahari, jagung, dan ular berbulu Quetzalcoatl.
description.en: Aztec, Maya, and Toltec cosmologies centered on solar cycles, maize agriculture, and feathered serpent deities.

description.id: Tradisi suku-suku Pribumi Amerika (Algonquian, Iroquois, Ojibwe, Diné) tentang roh alam dan peringatan moral lingkungan.
description.en: Native American tribal traditions (Algonquian, Iroquois, Ojibwe, Diné) honoring ecological balance and guardian spirits.
